title: A minimal HRT counterexample at the sharp Gelfand--Shilov threshold
summary: In a remarkable breakthrough, Faulhuber, Petersen, van Velthoven, and Voigtlaender disproved the Heil--Ramanathan--Topiwala conjecture by constructing twelve linearly dependent time--frequency shifts of a Schwartz function. The following day, the author compressed their vector-Zak and cohomological architecture to an explicit intrinsically subcritical four-point configuration, thereby attaining the minimum possible cardinality.
